name: music-library-frontend
description: Self-hosted music library web and desktop client

scripts.electron:compile: node scripts/electron-buildenv.mjs && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.setup.json
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.electron:build:mac:universal: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never --config electron-builder.cjs
